ideas.title: Investigating the Hudson River Tunnel Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the reasons behind the Trump administration's funding freeze for the Hudson River tunnels and its potential impact on the region.
questions: What are the reasons behind the funding freeze?
How will this affect the local economy?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of federal freezes on infrastructure projects and their impact on local economies.
